title: Unit 25 Consolidation: Political repression
goal: Review the unit on political repression: how repression worked, censorship and exile, the disappeared, resistance, and memory and justice.

items: I can use the passive with ser to say who was watched, arrested or tortured.
I can use se with a verb to say what was banned or done.
I can give a figure and its source with según.
I can use the gerund to say how people resisted.
I can contrast the imperfect and the present perfect to say how things have changed.
